6901.title: ARRIVAL – MANADO CITY TOUR – MAKATETE HILL – SUN BAE MANADO
6901.description:
Upon arrival at Sam Ratulangi Airport Manado, the group will be welcomed by the tour guide and begin a city tour of Manado. Visit the city center, Chinatown, and Ban Hin Kiong Temple - the oldest temple in Manado, built in the 18th century (±300 years old). 

 

Continue by passing Sentrum Church, the first Protestant church in North Sulawesi from the Dutch era, and the World War II Monument, which marks the destruction of Manado in 1942 by Japanese forces. 

 

The tour then proceeds to the Ring Road area of CitraLand to see the Blessing Jesus Monument, a statue of Jesus built in a unique forward-leaning position overlooking Manado City. 

 

After that, visit Makatete Hill - located at 200 meters above sea level, offering panoramic views of Manado City, Manado Tua Island, Bunaken Island, Siladen Island, the open sea, and Mount Klabat, the highest peak in North Sulawesi.

 

Optional dinner at a local restaurant. After dinner, visit SunBae, one of Manado’s trendy seaside hangout spots, where guests may enjoy the evening atmosphere along with various snacks and drinks from numerous food stalls (optional). Afterwards, transfer to the hotel for check-in and rest.

6902.title: BUNAKEN SIGHTSEEING TOUR – LOCAL COFFEE PRODUCTION HOUSE – SHOPPING TOUR
6902.description:
After breakfast at the hotel, the tour participants will be picked up by the guide and head to Bunaken Island. From the hotel, transfer to Megamas Pier and cross to Bunaken by boat for approximately 30 minutes. 

 

Bunaken Island now features the newly developed Bunaken Tourism Pier (New Bunaken), offering a more charming and photogenic spot for photos and videos.

 

Afterwards, the tour participants will be taken to explore the beauty of Bunaken Marine Park, renowned for its colorful coral reefs and diverse tropical marine life. Participants may enjoy optional snorkeling or diving activities or simply take a leisurely walk while relaxing and enjoying the beach atmosphere of Bunaken. 

 

Optional lunch at a local restaurant. After lunch, guests will have additional free time for optional snorkeling/diving.

 

Return to Megamas Pier and proceed to visit a local coffee production house, where participants can taste the authentic flavors of North Sulawesi coffee. Afterwards, continue to a souvenir shopping area offering a wide variety of Manado specialties (or return to the hotel first and be picked up again before dinner).

 

Optional dinner at a local restaurant, followed by transfer back to the hotel.

6903.title: MINAHASA HIGHLAND TOUR
6903.description:
After breakfast at the hotel, the participants will be picked up by the tour guide for a full-day excursion to the Minahasa Highlands, passing through the Tinoor area where guests can enjoy panoramic views of Manado City from an altitude of 500 meters. 

 

Upon arrival in Tomohon, visit the Pelangi Tourism Park, where participants can admire the beauty of various colorful flowers. Continue to the Tomohon Extreme Market, where guests can see a variety of wild meats such as bats, forest rats, snakes, and other exotic animals. At a separate spot, guests may also witness the live cooking process of Manado traditional snacks such as kue cucur, apang gula merah, dodol, and other local delicacies.

 

The tour continues to Tuur Maasering, a forest of aren (palm) trees featuring several Instagrammable photo spots. Here, participants can also observe the traditional production of the local liquor “Cap Tikus,” made through the fermentation and distillation of aren tree sap.

 

Optional lunch at a local restaurant. After lunch, the journey continues to Bukit Kasih, a unique natural attraction featuring active sulfur craters and stairways leading to the hilltop, offering scenic views and a distinctive cultural experience. The area also has natural sulfur hot springs where guests may swim or soak their feet for relaxation (optional).

 

Next, visit Lake Linow, a sulfur lake famous for its ever-changing watercolors and beautiful scenery, where coffee or tea will be served. Return to Manado City. Optional dinner at a local restaurant, followed by transfer back to the hotel.

6904.title: TRANSFER OUT – DEPARTURE
6904.description: After breakfast and completing the hotel check-out process, the tour participants will be picked up by the guide and transferred directly to the airport for their return flight. Tour ends.

6907.title: LIHAGA ISLAND – BUDO TOURISM VILLAGE
6907.description:
After breakfast at the hotel, the participants will be picked up by the tour guide and travel to the Likupang area, approximately 1 hour and 20 minutes from Manado city center. The first stop is Serei Port, and upon arrival, continue by boat for about 15 minutes to Lihaga Island.

 

On Lihaga Island, participants can enjoy its stunning white and powder-soft sandy beaches, explore the island, and take photos at various beautiful and Instagrammable spots. Guests may also join optional activities such as snorkeling, canoeing, or diving. Lunch will be served on the island. After lunch, participants will have additional free time to relax by the beach.

 

On the return journey to Manado, make a stop at Budo Tourism Village, where guests can enjoy a beautiful sunset accompanied by local treats of fried bananas and fresh coconut. 

 

Optional dinner at a local restaurant, followed by transfer back to the hotel.

6908.title: TRANSFER OUT – DEPARTURE

2756.title: Itinerary
2756.description:
Meet & greet at Mount Tumpa at 10:00 AM.

 

Paragliding at Mount Tumpa is an unforgettable experience for adventure enthusiasts and nature lovers alike. Flying at an altitude of around 1,000 meters, you will feel the thrilling sensation of soaring freely like a bird while enjoying breathtaking views of the mountain landscape, lush green forests, and the crystal-clear blue sea below. 

 

The paragliding site at Mount Tumpa is also a safe and ideal place for both beginners and those looking to improve their paragliding skills, thanks to its stable weather conditions and gentle winds. You will be accompanied by professional paragliding instructors and provided with proper safety equipment. 

 

Paragliding at Mount Tumpa is a thrilling yet beautiful experience that will make your trip to Manado truly unforgettable.

2755.title: Itinerary
2755.description:
Participants will be picked up in the morning for a tour to Rap-Rap Beach. Upon arrival, participants will enjoy a unique experience at the stunning Rap-Rap Beach, starting with a canoe ride through the calm waters surrounding the lush mangrove forest. Within minutes, participants will embark on an exciting search for the Tarsius, a fascinating tiny primate often found among the mangrove trees. 

 

The serene natural atmosphere and the sounds of the forest accompany this journey, creating an unforgettable moment amid the beauty of North Sulawesi’s nature. When spotting the Tarsius, participants are free to take photos and capture the moment. 

 

Afterward, the tour continues back to the Rap-Rap shoreline before heading to the highlands of Mount Tumpa, where participants can witness a beautiful sunset view from the foothills while enjoying various traditional Manado snacks such as pisang goreng sambal roa, batata goreng gula merah, and es kacang brenebon (optional, at personal expense). Afterward, participants will be transferred back to the meeting point. End of tour.

6973.title: Itinerary
6973.description:
All participants will be picked up for a trip to Tunan Waterfall, located in Talawaan Village. The water source of Tunan Waterfall originates from a mountain river that flows forcefully down a steep cliff about 86 meters high. The pristine forest and natural surroundings enhance the beauty of this scenic natural attraction.

 

Afterward, participants will enjoy lunch at a local restaurant. The journey then continues to the Tangkoko Nature Reserve. Sit back and relax while enjoying the beautiful scenery as you pass through small villages on the way to one of Indonesia’s most important conservation areas.

 

Located about 20 kilometers northwest of Bitung, the reserve lies among hills and valleys. Upon arrival, you will be greeted by a local park ranger, who will guide you through the forest in search of various wildlife species roaming freely in their natural habitat. Keep your camera ready—you may encounter the Sulawesi Black Crested Macaque (Yaki), the Tarsius Tarsier (the world’s smallest primate), as well as Hornbills and Cuscus (large-eyed marsupials). 

 

After the wildlife exploration, return to Manado. End of tour.

2753.title: Itinerary
2753.description:
Mount Lokon is one of the largest mountains in Tomohon and is an active volcano standing at an elevation of 1,580 meters above sea level. True to its name, “Lokon” means the oldest and the greatest. Its active crater, known as Tompaluan Crater, is located at the mountain’s base. 

 

From the pick-up point, you will drive to Tomohon or the foothills of Mount Lokon (approximately 1 hour and 30 minutes), then continue with a hike of about 2 hours to reach the crater rim. Currently, the trek does not go beyond the crater, which lies about halfway to the summit. 

 

Mount Lokon offers spectacular natural scenery and a thrilling challenge for hikers. Along the trail, you can enjoy breathtaking views, including the beautiful panorama of Tomohon city. 

 

After the trekking adventure, proceed to a local restaurant for lunch. Following lunch, return to Manado city and drop off at the designated point. End of tour.

7359.title: Itinerary
7359.description:
Participants will be picked up in the morning for a tour to Mount Mahawu, located approximately 1 hour and 15 minutes from Manado city. Mount Mahawu is a popular attraction for tourists and hikers visiting Manado. The hiking trail consists of around 150 cemented steps, making the climb relatively easy. Along the way, participants will find metal railings that can be used for support during the ascent. Upon reaching the summit, participants can enjoy stunning panoramic views of Manado Tua Island, Bunaken, and Manado city. 

 

The tour then continues to Tetetana Hill Peak, a newly developed tourist destination in Tomohon. In addition to offering panoramic views of four regions across North Sulawesi Province, visitors can also enjoy the beauty of the hill, surrounded by colorful flower gardens. 

 

Afterward, the group will head to a local restaurant for lunch. Following lunch, participants will return to Manado city and be dropped off at the designated pick-up point. End of tour.

2751.title: Itinerary
2751.description:
Participants will be picked up at the meeting point in the morning and transferred to the Rafting Location in Timbukar Village, Sonder. Before starting the rafting activity, participants will receive a short training session, including basic movements and safety instructions to maintain balance while on the rubber boat. 

 

During the rafting trip, participants will be accompanied by two experienced rafting guides equipped with internationally standardized safety gear. While navigating the exciting rapids of the Nimanga River, participants can also enjoy the stunning natural scenery along the way for approximately 90 minutes. 

 

Afterward, return to Manado city and drop off at the meeting point. Tour ends.

5019.title: Itinerary
5019.description:
The tour participants will be picked up in the morning by the tour guide for a journey to the Minahasa Highlands, passing through the Tinoor area where participants can enjoy a view of Manado city from an elevation of 500 meters. Upon arrival in Tomohon, the group will visit Taman Wisata Pelangi, where they can admire the beauty of various colorful flowers. 

 

The next stop is the Tomohon Extreme Market, where participants can get a close look at various types of wild animal meat, such as paniki (bat), forest rats, snakes, and other wild animals. At a different location, participants will also have the chance to witness the live cooking process of traditional Manado cakes like cucur, apang gula merah, dodol, and other local sweet treats. 

 

Next, the tour heads to the Aren forest with Instagram-worthy photo spots at Tuur Maasering. In addition to the interesting photo spots, participants will also observe the process of making the local liquor 'Cap Tikus', which is produced through the fermentation and distillation of sap from the Aren tree. 

 

Lunch will be served at a local restaurant by Lake Tondano. After lunch, the journey continues to Bukit Kasih, a unique natural attraction featuring active sulfur craters and stairways leading to the hilltop, offering scenic views and a distinctive cultural experience. The area also has natural sulfur hot springs where guests may swim or soak their feet for relaxation (optional). 

 

The journey continues to Lake Linow, a sulfur lake known for its changing watercolors and beautiful, tranquil scenery (served with coffee or tea). Afterward, return to Manado City. Dinner is optional. After dinner, participants will be transferred back to the designated drop-off point. Tour ends.

2749.title: Itinerary
2749.description:
Meet & greet at 08:00 AM with the tour guide at Megamas Pier for a day tour to Bunaken Island. From Megamas Pier, cross to Bunaken Island by boat (approximately 30 minutes). Currently, Bunaken has been beautifully revitalized with its new and more representative Bunaken Tourism Pier (New Bunaken), where participants can capture stunning photos and videos with scenic island views. 

 

Discover the underwater beauty of Bunaken Marine Park, home to vibrant coral reefs and colorful tropical fish, through optional snorkeling or diving activities. Participants may also enjoy free time to relax and explore the island’s serene beach atmosphere. Lunch will be served at a local beachfront restaurant. 

 

After lunch, enjoy more free leisure time or continue snorkeling/diving (optional). In the afternoon, return to Megamas Pier, Manado. End of tour.

5018.title: Itinerary
5018.description:
Tour participants will be picked up by the tour guide at the pick-up point and will immediately begin the City Tour: heading to the city center of Manado, the Chinatown area, and the Ban Hin Kiong Temple (the oldest temple in Manado, built in the 18th century, approximately 300 years old). 

 

The tour will also pass by the Sentrum Church (the first Protestant church in North Sulawesi, a remnant from the Dutch colonial era) and the World War II Monument (a reminder of the destruction of Manado city in 1942 by Japanese soldiers). Lunch will be served at a local restaurant with a specialty Tuna dish, cooked in the traditional Manado style. 

 

Afterward, the tour will head to the Ring Road Citra Land area to get a closer look at the charm of the Jesus Blessing Monument – a statue of Jesus built in a floating position, facing the city of Manado. Then, the tour will continue to Makatete Hill – a hilltop at an elevation of 200 meters above sea level, offering views of Manado city, Manado Island, Bunaken Island, Siladen Island, vast stretches of the sea, and the Klabat Mountain, the highest mountain in North Sulawesi. 

 

Dinner is optional. After dinner, participants will be dropped back off at the pick-up point. The tour concludes.

7481.title: ARRIVAL – Explore TUNAN WATERFALL
7481.description:
Arrival at Manado in the morning. Meet our guide, then proceed to the picked up to go to Tunan Waterfall, this waterfall is in Talawan Village. The source of the Tunan Waterfall comes from the river above the mountain which flows quite rapidly through steep cliffs with a cliff height of approximately 86 meters. The atmosphere of the natural forest that is still pristine and natural adds to the beauty around the Tunan Waterfall Nature Tourism object.

 

 We drive right to Tangkoko National Park (if you arrive in the afternoon, skip the Tunan Waterfall trip and go straight to Batu Putih village in Tangkoko). At the end of the afternoon, a short hike in the forest in search of the big star of the park: the Tarsier Spectrum, the smallest mammal on the planet. Tangkoko Sanctuary Villa is where you will spend the night.

7482.title: FULL DAY TANGKOKO TOUR
7482.description:
After finishing breakfast at the homestay, start to explore the endemic species of North Sulawesi at the Tangkoko Nature Reserve. Search for the Black Crested Macaque (Black Monkey indigenous to North Sulawesi), another Tarsier Spectrum (the world’s smallest primate), Cuscus bear, and lots of birds. The national park is home to the world's highest population of hornbills, including the rhinoceros hornbill. 

 

After lunch we'll go on another excursion into Tangkoko's jungle in the afternoon. Overnight at homestay.

7483.title: WARUGA SAWANGAN – MINAHASA HIGHLAND TOUR
7483.description:
After breakfast, check out and drive to the highlands, then proceed to the Waruga Sawangan, with a halt at the ancient Minahasa People's Tomb (Giant Stone Ages). Having lunch at Tondano Lake. Proceed to Tomohon to see the traditional market, after that Woloan Village knock-down wooden house industry (locals here create exquisite Minahasa-style wooden homes that are disassembled and shipped out of their village), and Kai’santi Tomohon which is a photo stop with a scenic backdrop of Mt. Lokon & green rice fields. 

 

We spend the afternoon at Linow Lake drinking coffee or tea. check in to your room in a resort in Tomohon.

7484.title: Mt. MAHAWU TREKKING – BUNAKEN ISLAND
7484.description:
After breakfast at the hotel, check-out. Meet our guide, then proceed to the Mt. Mahawu crater. After a 10-minute hike to the crater's rim, you'll be rewarded with a breathtaking view of Tomohon and Manado, as well as the islands beyond, at the crater's bottom, visitors can see a steaming lake and smell sulfur from the pools. After lunch, transfer by boat to the island of Bunaken (approximately 45 minutes by boat). 

 

Bunaken Marine Park is a marine park in North Sulawesi, Indonesia, east of Bunaken Island. This marine park is well-known for its breathtaking underwater scenery. Bunaken Marine Park, with an area of roughly 89,065 hectares, is a popular destination for divers and snorkelers from all over the world. Lodging will be provided at Resorts on Bunaken Island

7485.title: BUNAKEN ISLAND (SWIMMING / SNORKELING)
7485.description:
We freely enjoy the pleasures of the sea in one of Indonesia's most gorgeous snorkeling sites. We're in the midst of a magnificent ecosystem with over 500 coral types and approximately 1,500 fish species, harmless reef sharks, and Turtles are frequently spotted surrounding the island.

 

Note: as an option, it is possible to rent snorkeling equipment and do it from the beach or book a boat trip. Diving outings are also possible (reservation and payment on site)

7486.title: TRANSFER OUT TO AIRPORT
7486.description: After breakfast at the hotel, check-out. Transfer by boat to Manado, Next, you will be escorted by our tour guide to the airport for transfer out. Tour is over, Thank you.

6888.title: ARRIVAL – TUNAN WATERFALL  – TANGKOKO NATURE RESERVE PARK

The source of the Tunan Waterfall comes from the river above the mountain which flows quite rapidly through steep cliffs with a cliff height of approximately 86 meters. The atmosphere of the natural forest that is still pristine and natural adds to the beauty around the Tunan Waterfall Nature Tourism object. 

 

We drive right to Tangkoko National Park (If you arrive in the afternoon, skip the Tunan Waterfall trip and go straight to Batu Putih village in Tangkoko). At the end of the afternoon, a short hike in the forest in search of the big star of the park: the Tarsier Spectrum, the smallest mammal on the planet. Tangkoko Homestay is where you will spend the night.

6889.title: FULL DAY TANGKOKO TOUR
6889.description: After finishing breakfast at the homestay, start to explore the endemic species of North Sulawesi at the Tangkoko Nature Reserve. Search for the Black Crested Macaque (Black Monkey indigenous to North Sulawesi), another Tarsier Spectrum (the world’s smallest primate), Cuscus bear, and lots of birds. The national park is home to the world's highest population of hornbills, including the rhinoceros hornbill. After lunch we'll go on another excursion into Tangkoko's jungle in the afternoon. Overnight at homestay.

6890.title: WARUGA SAWANGAN – MINAHASA HIGHLAND TOUR
6890.description:
After breakfast, check out and drive to the highlands, then proceed to the Waruga Sawangan, with a halt at the ancient Minahasa People's Tomb (Giant Stone Ages). Having lunch at Tondano Lake. Proceed to Tomohon to see the traditional market, after that Woloan Village knock-down wooden house industry (locals here create exquisite Minahasa-style wooden homes that are disassembled and shipped out of their village), and Kai’santi Tomohon which is a photo stop with a scenic backdrop of Mt. Lokon & green rice fields. 

 

We spend the afternoon at Linow Lake drinking coffee or tea. check in to your room in a resort in Tomohon.

6891.title: MT. MAHAWU - TRANSFER OUT TO AIRPORT
6891.description: After breakfast at the hotel, check-out. Meet our guide, then proceed to the Mt. Mahawu crater. After a 10-minute hike to the crater's rim, you'll be rewarded with a breathtaking view of Tomohon and Manado, as well as the islands beyond, at the crater's bottom, visitors can see a steaming lake and smell sulfur from the pools. Next, you will be escorted by our tour guide to the airport for transfer out.

6892.title: ARRIVAL – MINAHASA HIGHLAND  – TANGKOKO NATURE RESERVE PARK
6892.description:
Arrival at Manado in the morning. Meet our guide, then proceed to the Mt. Mahawu crater. After a 10-minute hike to the crater's rim, you'll be rewarded with a breathtaking view of Tomohon and Manado, as well as the islands beyond. After that visit Woloan village, the center of the knock-down traditional home business, and make a stop at the Pagoda Buddhist Temple, which is a photo stop with a scenic backdrop of Mt. Lokon. Chilling down at Linow Lake's gorgeous multi-color to enjoy the afternoon at a nice restaurant by the lake sipping coffee or tea.

 

The trek continues to the Waruga Sawangan, with a halt at the ancient Minahasa People's Tomb (Giant Stone Ages). Take the road to Tangkoko. (If you arrive in the afternoon, skip the Minahasa Highland trip and go straight to Batu Putih village in Tangkoko). Tangkoko Homestay is where you will spend the night.

6893.title: FULL DAY TANGKOKO TOUR
6893.description:
After finishing breakfast at the homestay, start to explore the endemic species of North Sulawesi at the Tangkoko Nature Reserve. Search for the Black Crested Macaque (Black Monkey indigenous to North Sulawesi), the Tarsier Spectrum (the world’s smallest primate), Cuscus bear, and lots of birds.

6894.title: TRANSFER OUT TO AIRPORT
6894.description: After breakfast at the hotel, check-out. Make a visit in town for souvenir shopping if time allows. Next, you will be escorted by our tour guide to the airport for transfer out. Tour is over, Thank you.

5010.title: ITINERARY
5010.description:
Meet & greet at 08:00 AM with the tour guide at Megamas Pier for a day tour of Island Hopping. From Megamas Pier, cross to Bunaken Island by boat (approximately 30 minutes). 

 

Upon arrival, guests will visit Bunaken Marine Park, renowned for its stunning coral reefs and thousands of colorful fish species surrounding Bunaken Island. Bunaken Island now features a more attractive and well-developed area, including the Bunaken Tourism Pier, where participants can take photos with family and friends. 

 

Afterward, guests may enjoy optional snorkeling or diving activities; they can also swim while feeding fish directly by hand. Lunch will be served at a local restaurant on Bunaken Island. 

 

After lunch, proceed to visit Siladen Island and the Nain Sandbank. On each island, participants can capture moments through photos or videos, take a walk, and enjoy the natural beauty of Siladen Island and the Nain Sandbank. 

 

In the afternoon, return to Megamas Pier, Manado. End of tour.

4915.title: ITINERARY
4915.description:
After breakfast at your hotel in Manado, depart for Mount Soputan, one of the most active volcanoes in North Sulawesi, renowned for its dramatic volcanic scenery and breathtaking natural landscapes.

🕐 Travel time from Manado to the base of Mount Soputan: approximately 2.5–3 hours by car, depending on traffic and weather conditions.

Along the journey, enjoy scenic countryside views, coconut plantations, and the beautiful mountainous landscapes of North Sulawesi, making the drive itself part of the experience.

Upon arrival at the trekking point, prepare for an exciting hike to Mount Soputan. The trekking route features a unique combination of lush forest trails, open savannah, volcanic rock formations, and spectacular landscapes shaped by past volcanic activity.

🕐 Estimated trekking duration (round trip): approximately 4–5 hours, depending on weather conditions, fitness level, and walking pace.

📸 Enjoy stunning panoramic views and dramatic volcanic terrain along the way — a rewarding experience for nature lovers, photographers, and adventure seekers alike.

After completing the trek, return to the vehicle and transfer back to your hotel in Manado for a well-deserved rest.

6922.title: ARRIVAL MANADO - PARADISE GOLF RESORT
6922.description:
Upon arrival at Sam Ratulangi International Airport Manado, you will be welcomed by our team and transferred directly to Paradise Hotel & Golf Resort, set along the coast of North Sulawesi amid calm surroundings and refreshing scenery.

The drive to the resort takes approximately 60–90 minutes. On arrival, check in and spend the rest of the day resting or enjoying the resort facilities. Take in the relaxed atmosphere, the fresh air, and the views of the golf course stretching across a beautiful tropical landscape.

Overnight at Paradise Hotel & Golf Resort.

6923.title: PARADISE GOLF EXPERIENCE (18 HOLES)
6923.description:
After breakfast at the hotel, it is time to enjoy a round on one of the finest golf courses in North Sulawesi.

Play a full 18 holes with golf cart and caddy included. The course combines challenging fairways with striking natural panoramas, making for an enjoyable round for experienced golfers and beginners alike.

After the game, you are free to relax at the resort, take in the surroundings, or spend time with family and fellow travelers.

Overnight at Paradise Hotel & Golf Resort.

6924.title: LIHAGA ISLAND WHITE SAND ESCAPE
6924.description:
After breakfast, continue to Serei Port and cross by private boat to Lihaga Island, one of the most beautiful tropical islands in North Sulawesi, known for its exceptionally fine white sand and clear turquoise water.

Enjoy time to relax on the beach, swim, take photos, or simply take in the unspoiled beauty of the island. For those who want more activity, optional snorkeling, canoeing, and glass-bottom boat rides are available to explore the underwater scenery around the island.

Lunch is served on the island with a North Sulawesi specialty of freshly grilled fish accompanied by Manado’s signature dabu-dabu sambal. After enjoying Lihaga Island, return to Serei Port and continue back to the hotel.

The afternoon is free to rest and enjoy the resort atmosphere.

Overnight at Paradise Hotel & Golf Resort.

6925.title: DEPARTURE MANADO
6925.description:
After breakfast and hotel check-out, you have free time before departure.

At the appointed time, our team will transfer you to Sam Ratulangi International Airport Manado for your onward flight.

As this journey comes to an end, we hope that the golf and the beauty of Lihaga Island will remain a fond memory of your holiday in North Sulawesi.

End of Program

5160.title: ARRIVAL MANADO - PARADISE GOLF RESORT
5160.description:
Upon arrival at Sam Ratulangi International Airport Manado, you will be welcomed by our team and transferred to Paradise Hotel & Golf Resort on the coast of North Sulawesi. The drive takes approximately 60–90 minutes, with beautiful countryside and coastline along the way.

On arrival at the resort, check in and spend the rest of the day relaxing in its quiet setting, using the hotel facilities, or taking in the views of the golf course overlooking the sea. The first day is designed as time to unwind before the main activities begin the following morning.

Overnight at Paradise Hotel & Golf Resort.

5161.title: PARADISE GOLF EXPERIENCE (18 HOLES)
5161.description:
After breakfast, enjoy a round on one of the finest golf courses in North Sulawesi. The course combines challenging fairways with fresh sea air and tropical panoramas that are a pleasure to play through.

The 18-hole round includes green fee, golf cart, and caddy, so you can play in complete comfort. Afterwards, free time can be spent resting, using the resort facilities, or simply relaxing in the calm tropical surroundings.

Overnight at Paradise Hotel & Golf Resort.

5162.title: BUNAKEN ISLAND SIGHTSEEING EXPERIENCE
5162.description:
After breakfast and check-out from the resort, continue to Manado City and Megamas Pier. From here you will cross by boat to Bunaken Island, a trip of approximately 45 minutes.

On arrival at Bunaken, take time to explore the redeveloped New Bunaken area, with its many attractive spots looking straight out onto the blue Sulawesi Sea. The island offers beautiful beach scenery, a calm tropical atmosphere, and plenty of locations ideal for photography and for simply enjoying the natural beauty.

For those who wish to explore further, optional snorkeling or diving is available to experience the world-renowned Bunaken Marine Park. Lunch is served with freshly grilled fish and Manado’s signature dabu-dabu sambal.

In the afternoon, return to Manado and continue to your selected hotel in the city center for check-in and rest.

Overnight at a selected hotel in Manado.

5163.title: DEPARTURE MANADO
5163.description:
After breakfast at the hotel, you have free time before departure. At the appointed time, our team will collect you and transfer you to Sam Ratulangi International Airport Manado for your onward flight.

As this journey comes to an end, we hope that the seaside golf and the beauty of Bunaken Island will remain a fond memory of your holiday in North Sulawesi.

End of Program

5156.title: ARRIVAL MANADO - PARADISE GOLF RESORT
5156.description:
Upon arrival at Sam Ratulangi International Airport Manado, you will be welcomed by our team and transferred directly to Paradise Hotel & Golf Resort. The drive offers the calm, refreshing atmosphere of the North Sulawesi coast.

On arrival at the resort, check in and spend the rest of the day relaxing with the hotel facilities, the views over the golf course, or simply the comfortable tropical surroundings. The first day is designed as time to unwind before the golf experience begins the next morning.

Overnight at Paradise Hotel & Golf Resort.

5157.title: PARADISE GOLF EXPERIENCE (18 HOLES)
5157.description:
After breakfast at the hotel, enjoy a round at Paradise Golf Course, which combines challenging fairways with striking natural scenery.

The 18-hole round includes green fee, golf cart, and caddy, so you can focus on your game in complete comfort. After play, free time can be spent relaxing at the resort or joining the optional activities available around the hotel area.

Overnight at Paradise Hotel & Golf Resort.

5158.title: PARADISE GOLF EXPERIENCE (18 HOLES)
5158.description:
Breakfast at the hotel before the second golf session. Today is a chance to play the course again and appreciate how each hole has a character of its own, in the calm tropical setting and fresh air of North Sulawesi.

After the round, enjoy free time to rest, use the resort facilities, or join optional activities such as snorkeling or a glass-bottom boat ride available in the resort area.

Overnight at Paradise Hotel & Golf Resort.

5159.title: DEPARTURE MANADO
5159.description:
After breakfast and hotel check-out, you have free time before departure.

At the appointed time, our team will transfer you to Sam Ratulangi International Airport Manado for your onward flight. As this journey comes to an end, we hope that your golf at Paradise Golf Resort will remain a fond memory of your time in North Sulawesi.

End of Program

7478.title: ARRIVAL MANADO - PARADISE GOLF RESORT
7478.description:
Upon arrival at Sam Ratulangi International Airport Manado, or at an agreed pick-up point, you will be welcomed by our team and transferred to Paradise Hotel & Golf Resort on the coast of North Sulawesi. The drive takes approximately 60–90 minutes through green landscapes and quiet countryside.

On arrival at the resort, check in and enjoy free time to rest or explore the grounds. Take in the relaxed atmosphere, the beautiful views over the golf course, and the fresh sea air that makes this resort an ideal place to leave the daily routine behind.

Overnight at Paradise Hotel & Golf Resort.

7479.title: PARADISE GOLF EXPERIENCE (18 HOLES)
7479.description:
After breakfast at the hotel, it is time to play Paradise Golf Course. The course combines challenging fairways with striking tropical panoramas, making for an enjoyable round for beginners and experienced golfers alike.

The 18-hole round includes green fee, golf cart, and caddy, so you can play in complete comfort. Afterwards, free time can be spent relaxing at the resort, using the hotel facilities, or joining optional activities such as snorkeling or a glass-bottom boat ride available in the resort area.

Toward late afternoon, enjoy the quiet of the resort while watching the sunset over the coast of North Sulawesi.

Overnight at Paradise Hotel & Golf Resort.

7480.title: DEPARTURE MANADO
7480.description:
After breakfast at the hotel, enjoy free time before check-out. There is still an opportunity to take in the resort atmosphere or take photos around the grounds before departure.

At the appointed time, our team will transfer you to Sam Ratulangi International Airport Manado, or to your destination in Manado City, to continue your onward journey.

As this program comes to an end, we hope that the golf and the tropical atmosphere of North Sulawesi will remain a pleasant and memorable experience.

End of Program

5221.title: ARRIVAL MANADO – TRANSFER TO BANGKA ISLAND
5221.description:
Upon arrival at Sam Ratulangi International Airport Manado, you will be welcomed by our team and begin the journey to the pier for the crossing to Bangka Island. The combined road and sea transfer to the resort takes approximately 2 hours, following the beautiful northern coast of Sulawesi with views of the sea and its charming tropical islands.

On arrival at the Dive Resort, check in and enjoy free time to relax, walk around the grounds, or take in the quiet atmosphere of the beach. Dinner is served at the resort before you rest and prepare for the underwater adventure that begins the next morning.

5222.title: BANGKA DIVING EXPERIENCE
5222.description:
After breakfast, enjoy diving at a selection of dive sites around the Bangka Archipelago, an area known for its combination of colorful soft corals, healthy hard corals, and extraordinary marine biodiversity.

The waters of Bangka have a character of their own, bringing together the wall diving for which Bunaken is famous and the muck diving of the Lembeh Strait. During the dives you may encounter a wide range of tropical fish, macro marine life, and spectacular underwater formations.

Once the day’s diving is over, return to the resort and enjoy free time to relax in the peaceful setting of the island.

5223.title: BANGKA DIVING EXPERIENCE
5223.description:
Breakfast at the resort before continuing to explore the underwater world of Bangka. Today you will visit different dive sites offering varied scenery, from colorful reefs and underwater pinnacles to submerged walls that shelter a wide range of tropical marine species.

With more than 40 dive sites spread across the Bangka Archipelago, every dive brings something new for beginners and experienced divers alike.

Return to the resort in the afternoon and enjoy time to unwind on the beach or at the resort facilities.

5224.title: BANGKA DIVING EXPERIENCE
5224.description:
After breakfast, continue the diving adventure and explore more of the underwater beauty of the Bangka Archipelago. The area is regarded as one of the finest diving destinations in North Sulawesi, with clear water and a marine ecosystem that remains remarkably well preserved.

Take this last opportunity to see the wealth of tropical marine life, the healthy coral reefs, and the underwater panoramas that make Bangka a hidden gem for divers in Indonesia.

After the dives, return to the resort for a relaxed afternoon and your final dinner on the island.

5225.title: BANGKA ISLAND - DEPARTURE
5225.description:
After breakfast and check-out, the return journey to Manado begins with a boat transfer to the mainland, continuing to Sam Ratulangi International Airport Manado or to your selected hotel in the city.

As this journey comes to an end, we hope that exploring the underwater beauty of the Bangka Archipelago will remain an unforgettable memory and a new story from one of the finest diving destinations in North Sulawesi.

End of Program

5226.title: ARRIVAL MANADO - TRANSFER TO LEMBEH ISLAND
5226.description:
Upon arrival at Sam Ratulangi International Airport Manado, you will be welcomed by our team and set off directly for the pier and the crossing to Lembeh Island. The transfer to the resort takes approximately 1 hour and 40 minutes, combining road travel and a boat transfer along the beautiful coastline of North Sulawesi.

On arrival at the resort, check in and enjoy free time to rest, walk around the grounds, or take in the calm of Lembeh Island, known as one of the finest diving destinations in the world. Dinner is served at the resort before you rest and prepare for the underwater adventure that begins the next morning.

5227.title: LEMBEH STRAIT DIVING EXPERIENCE
5227.description:
After breakfast, the diving adventure begins at a selection of dive sites in the Lembeh Strait, renowned as one of the best muck diving locations in the world. Its black volcanic sand forms a unique habitat that is home to a remarkable range of rare and exotic marine species.

During the dives you may find many of the creatures most prized by underwater photographers, from frogfish and nudibranchs to species that are difficult to encounter anywhere else. After two morning dives, return to the resort for a relaxed afternoon and dinner.

5228.title: LEMBEH MACRO DIVING ADVENTURE
5228.description:
Breakfast at the resort before continuing to explore the underwater world of the Lembeh Strait. Today you will visit different dive sites, offering an even better chance of finding the macro life that has made Lembeh famous among international divers and professional photographers.

Enjoy calm diving conditions with relatively light currents and visibility well suited to macro photography. After the dives, return to the resort and use the free time to relax in the peaceful setting of the island.

5229.title: LEMBEH UNDERWATER EXPLORATION
5229.description:
After breakfast, continue into the final day of diving and explore more of the best sites in the Lembeh Strait. Alongside its extraordinary macro life, several areas also offer wrecks and wide-angle spots well worth exploring.

Today is your last opportunity to enjoy the world-renowned marine biodiversity of Lembeh. After the dives, return to the resort and spend a relaxed afternoon by the beach before your final dinner on the island.

5230.title: LEMBEH ISLAND - DEPARTURE
5230.description:
After breakfast and check-out, the return journey to Manado begins with a boat transfer to the mainland, continuing to Sam Ratulangi International Airport Manado or to your selected hotel in Manado City.

As this journey comes to an end, we hope that exploring the macro world beneath the Lembeh Strait will leave you with extraordinary memories and stand among the finest diving experiences of your time in Indonesia.

End of Program

6936.title: ARRIVAL MANADO
6936.description:
Upon arrival at Sam Ratulangi International Airport Manado, you will be welcomed by our team and transferred to your selected hotel or resort for check-in. The drive to your accommodation takes approximately 30–60 minutes depending on its location.

The rest of the day is yours to rest, enjoy the hotel facilities, or relax in the coastal atmosphere of North Sulawesi in preparation for the underwater adventure that begins the following morning.

Overnight at your selected hotel or resort.

6937.title: BUNAKEN DIVING EXPERIENCE
6937.description:
After breakfast, continue to Bunaken Marine Park, widely regarded as one of the finest diving destinations in Indonesia. Travelling by dive boat, you will visit a selection of dive sites to explore spectacular coral walls, colorful coral gardens, and a marine ecosystem rich in life.

Bunaken is renowned for its remarkable wall diving, excellent visibility, and the chance to see green turtles and hawksbill turtles, a wide range of tropical reef fish, and predators such as barracuda and reef sharks. After the dives, return to the hotel for lunch and free time.

6938.title: BUNAKEN DIVING EXPERIENCE
6938.description:
Breakfast before returning to explore the underwater beauty of Bunaken. Today you will visit different dive sites, each with a character of its own, combining coral gardens, reef walls, and abundant marine life.

Take the opportunity to observe a wide range of tropical marine species, from colorful reef fish to the small creatures that shelter among the corals. After the diving program, return to the hotel to rest and enjoy a relaxed afternoon.

6939.title: TUNAN WATERFALL & TANGKOKO WILDLIFE TOUR
6939.description:
After breakfast, travel to the Talawaan area to visit Tunan Waterfall, hidden deep in tropical forest. Falling from a height of about 86 meters, it offers a refreshing natural setting and is one of the hidden gems of North Sulawesi.

The journey continues to Tangkoko Nature Reserve, the best-known wildlife conservation area in North Sulawesi. Accompanied by an experienced local ranger, you will take a light trek through the rainforest in search of endemic species such as the Yaki (Sulawesi black crested macaque), tarsier, hornbill, and cuscus living freely in their natural habitat.

After this unique wildlife experience, return to Manado and back to your hotel.

6940.title: DEPARTURE MANADO
6940.description:
After breakfast and check-out, you will be collected and transferred to Sam Ratulangi International Airport Manado in line with your flight schedule.

As this journey comes to an end, we hope that exploring the underwater beauty of Bunaken and meeting the endemic wildlife of Sulawesi at Tangkoko will remain an unforgettable memory of your time in North Sulawesi.

End of Program

5236.title: ARRIVAL MANADO - TRANSFER TO BANGKA ISLAND
5236.description:
Upon arrival at Sam Ratulangi International Airport Manado, you will be welcomed by our team and begin the journey to the pier for the crossing to Bangka Island. The combined road and sea transfer takes approximately 2 hours, following the beautiful northern coast of Sulawesi with sweeping views of the sea and its tropical islands.

On arrival at the Dive Resort, check in and enjoy free time to relax by the beach, take in the sea views, or simply savor the quiet of a tropical island far from the crowds. Dinner is served at the resort.

5237.title: BANGKA DIVING EXPERIENCE
5237.description:
After breakfast, the underwater adventure begins with a selection of the best dive sites around the Bangka Archipelago. The area is known for a rare combination of Bunaken-style wall diving and Lembeh-style muck diving, offering strikingly varied dives within a single destination.

Enjoy colorful soft and hard corals, spectacular underwater formations, and the many tropical species that inhabit the waters of Bangka. After two morning dives, return to the resort for lunch and a relaxed afternoon.

5238.title: BANGKA DIVING EXPERIENCE
5238.description:
Breakfast at the resort before continuing to explore the underwater world of the Bangka Archipelago. Today you will visit different dive sites offering exceptionally well-preserved coral reefs, striking underwater pinnacles, and the wealth of marine life that makes Bangka one of the finest diving destinations in North Sulawesi.

After the dives, return to the resort and enjoy free time to relax on the beach and watch a beautiful sunset over Bangka Island.

5239.title: BANGKA ISLAND - DEPARTURE
5239.description:
After breakfast and check-out, the return journey to Manado begins with a boat transfer to the mainland, continuing by road to Sam Ratulangi International Airport Manado or to your selected hotel in Manado City.

As this program comes to an end, we hope that exploring the underwater beauty of the Bangka Archipelago and enjoying the calm of a tropical island will remain an unforgettable memory of your time in North Sulawesi.

End of Program

5252.title: ARRIVAL MANADO - TRANSFER TO LEMBEH ISLAND
5252.description:
Upon arrival at Sam Ratulangi International Airport Manado, you will be welcomed by our team and head directly to the pier to continue on to Lembeh Island. The transfer to the resort takes approximately 1 hour and 40 minutes, combining road travel and a boat transfer along the beautiful coast of North Sulawesi.

On arrival at the Dive Resort, check in and enjoy free time to relax in the calm of this tropical island. The afternoon can be spent resting or taking in views of the Lembeh Strait, a name well known to divers around the world. Dinner is served at the resort.

5253.title: LEMBEH STRAIT DIVING EXPERIENCE
5253.description:
After breakfast, the underwater adventure begins with two morning dives at some of the best sites in the Lembeh Strait. This destination is known as one of the world’s premier locations for muck diving and macro photography, its black volcanic sand forming a unique habitat for a great many rare marine species.

During the dives you may find unusual creatures such as frogfish, nudibranchs, and seahorses, along with other exotic subjects sought after by underwater photographers from around the world. After the dives, return to the resort for lunch and free time.

5254.title: LEMBEH MACRO DIVING ADVENTURE
5254.description:
Breakfast at the resort before continuing to explore the underwater world of the Lembeh Strait. Today you will return to a selection of dive sites offering extraordinary macro marine life and comfortable diving in relatively calm currents.

Every dive brings the chance to find something different, which is what makes Lembeh a favorite among underwater photographers and divers who want to see a side of marine life rarely encountered elsewhere. After the dives, return to the resort and enjoy a relaxed afternoon by the beach.

5255.title: LEMBEH ISLAND - DEPARTURE
5255.description:
After breakfast and check-out, the return journey to Manado begins with a boat transfer to the mainland, continuing by road to Sam Ratulangi International Airport Manado or to your selected hotel in Manado City.

As this journey comes to an end, we hope that exploring the macro diving of the Lembeh Strait will stand among the most memorable underwater adventures of your time in North Sulawesi.

End of Program

7474.title: ARRIVAL MANADO
7474.description:
Upon arrival at Sam Ratulangi International Airport Manado, you will be welcomed by our team and transferred to your selected hotel or resort for check-in.

The rest of the day is yours to rest after the journey, enjoy the resort facilities, or relax in the tropical atmosphere of North Sulawesi. Guests staying on Bunaken Island will continue by boat transfer to the resort, followed by free time to enjoy the beauty of the island and the surrounding sea.

Overnight at your selected hotel or resort.

7475.title: BUNAKEN DIVING EXPERIENCE
7475.description:
After breakfast, the diving adventure begins with a selection of the finest dive sites in Bunaken Marine Park. The area is famous for its spectacular vertical coral walls, colorful coral gardens, and extraordinary marine biodiversity.

During the dives you may see green and hawksbill turtles resting against the coral walls, a wide range of tropical fish, and predators such as barracuda and reef sharks passing by. After the diving program and lunch, return to the resort to relax on the beach or enjoy the resort facilities.

7476.title: DISCOVER MORE OF BUNAKEN'S UNDERWATER PARADISE
7476.description:
Breakfast before continuing to explore the underwater world of Bunaken. Today you will visit further dive sites with a different character, from broad coral gardens and beautiful reef slopes to the deep walls for which Bunaken Marine Park is known.

Alongside its larger marine life, Bunaken is also home to many fascinating small creatures such as nudibranchs, lionfish, seahorses, shrimp, and scorpionfish sheltering among the corals. After the dives, return to the resort and enjoy free time to relax in the peaceful setting of the island.

7477.title: DEPARTURE MANADO
7477.description:
After breakfast and check-out, you will be collected from your hotel or resort and transferred to Sam Ratulangi International Airport Manado in line with your flight schedule. Guests staying on Bunaken Island will begin with a boat transfer to the Manado mainland before continuing to the airport.

End of Program

7358.title: ITINERARY
7358.description:
After breakfast, our team will collect you from your hotel in Manado City. The journey continues to Serei Likupang Pier, with coastal and rural scenery typical of North Sulawesi along the way. On arrival at the pier, board a private boat to Lihaga Island, a tropical island known for its soft white sand, turquoise water, and unspoiled setting.

On Lihaga Island, enjoy free time to relax on the beach, swim in the clear water, or walk around the island and capture its natural beauty from its finest vantage points. For those who would like something more active, optional snorkeling, canoeing, and diving are available to enjoy the well-preserved underwater scenery. Lunch is served on the island amid the calm of the tropics.

In the afternoon, return by boat to Serei Likupang Pier and continue to Manado City. Before returning to your hotel, stop at a Manado souvenir center to shop for local delicacies, handicrafts, and keepsakes from North Sulawesi. After shopping, you will be transferred back to your hotel.

End of Tour

6223.title: ITINERARY
6223.description:
After breakfast, our team will collect you from your hotel in Manado City. The journey continues to Serei Likupang Pier, with coastal and rural scenery typical of North Sulawesi along the way. On arrival at the pier, board a private boat to the waters around Gangga Island, one of the best snorkeling destinations in the Likupang area. Here you can enjoy pristine coral reefs, a wealth of colorful tropical fish, and clear water with excellent visibility.

After the snorkeling, continue to Lihaga Island, known for its soft white sand and turquoise sea. Enjoy time to swim, relax on the shore, walk around the island, or capture the moment at the many photo spots set against striking tropical scenery. Lunch is served on Lihaga Island in its calm, natural surroundings.

In the afternoon, return by boat to Serei Likupang Pier before continuing overland to Manado City. Before returning to your hotel, stop at a Manado souvenir center to shop for local delicacies, handicrafts, and keepsakes from North Sulawesi. You will then be transferred back to your hotel, carrying an unforgettable experience of two of the most beautiful tropical islands in Likupang.

End of Tour

7763.title: ITINERARY
7763.description:
After breakfast, you will be collected from your hotel in central Manado City and taken to Bahowo Pier. From the pier, the journey continues by private boat to Manado Tua Island.

On arrival, the adventure begins with a trek up Mount Manado Tua lasting approximately 3 hours. The trail passes through tropical forest and village plantations of nutmeg, clove, coconut, banana, mango, and other tropical crops. Along the way you can take in the natural surroundings and, with a little luck, spot endemic Sulawesi wildlife such as the tarsier, Yaki (black crested macaque), and various endemic birds.

After the trek, continue by boat to Bunaken National Park. Enjoy time to explore the beauty of the Bunaken sea, with snorkeling or diving available as optional activities. A packed lunch is served and can be enjoyed on board.

After Bunaken, return to Bahowo Pier and transfer back to your hotel in Manado City.

7765.title: ITINERARY
7765.description:
Morning – Pick-up & Waruga Sawangan
You will be collected from your hotel in the Manado City area and set off for Waruga Sawangan, an ancient Minahasan burial complex holding hundreds of stone waruga. Here you can learn about the history, traditions, and cultural heritage of the Minahasan people.

Batu Angus & Snorkeling
The journey continues to Batu Angus, a striking stretch of coast formed by volcanic lava flows in the distant past. After lunch at a local restaurant, enjoy time to explore the waters of Batu Angus by snorkeling. The clear water allows you to take in coral reefs, tropical fish, and a diverse range of marine life.

Afternoon – Return to Manado
After enjoying the beach and the snorkeling, continue back to Manado City. You will be transferred to your hotel and the tour ends.

End of Tour.
